g.text: Pi-Gen imaging: flash and personalize one SD card (scripts/personalize-node.sh, macOS)
No flash script exists in the repo. CM4 Lite
boots from SD, so usbboot/rpiboot (present in
cmCluster/usbboot) is only needed for eMMC CM4s.
Flash pi-gen/deploy/*-ivalice.img to the SD card
(manual: Raspberry Pi Imager, balenaEtcher or dd)
Re-insert card, macOS mounts the FAT partition as "bootfs"
next host in order dalmasca, archadia, rozarria,
hostname [disk], role and IP from HOST_IPS table
find mount point (diskutil info bootfs, or <disk>s1)
WARNING two heads would fight for 10.42.0.1
role head and a head was written to a different disk < 24 h ago?
